Package-level reference for the default UI, Svelte, React, preview, Mermaid, and extension exports.

## `@mira-mde/default-ui`

```ts
import {
  createMiraDefaultEditor,
  defaultMiraFeatures,
  MiraFeature,
  resolveMiraDefaultFeatures,
  resolveMiraDefaultToolbarItems,
} from "@mira-mde/default-ui";
```

| Export                                 | Purpose                                                |
| :------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------- |
| `createMiraDefaultEditor`              | Imperatively mount the default editor into a DOM node. |
| `MiraFeature`                          | Stable feature flag names.                             |
| `defaultMiraFeatures`                  | Default resolved feature map.                          |
| `resolveMiraDefaultFeatures`           | Merge caller feature flags with defaults.              |
| `resolveMiraDefaultToolbarItems`       | Resolve built-in toolbar item availability.            |
| `resolveMiraDefaultToolbarActions`     | Merge custom toolbar actions.                          |
| `resolveMiraDefaultToolbarDefinitions` | Merge custom toolbar sections.                         |

It combines the Svelte editor, Lapis-aligned Markdown preview, toolbar, Mermaid support, and mode controls. ## Common Props
Prop Type Purpose
value string Current Markdown value.
mode "source" | "live-preview" | "preview" | "split" Active editor mode.
features MiraFeatureFlags Enable or disable default UI capabilities.
featureConfigs MiraDefaultFeatureConfigs Configure feature-specific behavior such as toolbar items.
extensions MiraExtension[] Add portable editor or preview extensions.
linkResolver MiraLinkResolver Resolve links and wikilinks for preview output.
assetResolver MiraAssetResolver Resolve image and embed assets.
sourcePath string Document path used by resolvers and source-aware behavior.
## Feature Flags ```ts import { MiraFeature } from "@mira-mde/default-ui"; const features = { [MiraFeature.Mermaid]: true, [MiraFeature.Tables]: true, [MiraFeature.SplitMode]: false, }; ``` Feature flags apply to the toolbar, extension setup, and valid mode list. A disabled mode is removed from the mode switcher and ignored by `setMode()`. | Feature flag | Controls | | :---------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------- | | `MiraFeature.Toolbar` | Default toolbar visibility. | | `MiraFeature.ModeSwitch` | View-mode toolbar control. | | `MiraFeature.Formatting` | Bold and italic toolbar actions. | | `MiraFeature.Headings` | Heading toolbar actions and heading controls. | | `MiraFeature.Lists` | Bullet, ordered, quote, and task list actions. | | `MiraFeature.Links` | Link insertion actions. | | `MiraFeature.Tables` | Pipe-table toolbar and live widgets. | | `MiraFeature.GridTables` | Grid-table toolbar and live widgets. | | `MiraFeature.Mermaid` | Mermaid extension and toolbar actions. | | `MiraFeature.Code` | Fenced-code toolbar actions. | | `MiraFeature.Math` | Math toolbar actions and rendering. | | `MiraFeature.Frontmatter` | Frontmatter property widget. | | `MiraFeature.Images` | Image behavior and toolbar availability. | | `MiraFeature.Embeds` | Markdown embed behavior. | | `MiraFeature.Wikilinks` | Wikilink behavior. | | `MiraFeature.Tags` | Tag rendering behavior. | | `MiraFeature.SourceMode` | Source mode availability. | | `MiraFeature.LivePreviewMode` | Live preview mode availability. | | `MiraFeature.PreviewMode` | Reading/preview mode availability. | | `MiraFeature.SplitMode` | Split mode availability. | ## Slash Commands The default editor enables a compact slash menu in source and live preview modes. Type `/` on an empty line to insert Markdown snippets for headings, lists, tasks, quotes, callouts, code, math, tables, grid tables, and Mermaid diagrams. Disable built-in snippets by id, or disable all built-ins when an app provides its own list: ```ts import { MiraFeature } from "@mira-mde/default-ui"; const featureConfigs = { [MiraFeature.SlashCommands]: { disableDefaultCommands: ["table", "gridTable"], }, }; ``` Custom snippets use the shared helper from `@mira-mde/extensions`. The `<|>` marker is removed before insertion and becomes the cursor position. ```ts import { createSlashSnippet } from "@mira-mde/extensions"; import { MiraFeature } from "@mira-mde/default-ui"; const featureConfigs = { [MiraFeature.SlashCommands]: { commands: [ createSlashSnippet({ id: "decision", label: "Decision", description: "Insert a decision callout", group: "Project", keywords: ["adr", "choice"], markdown: "> [!note] Decision\n> <|>", }), ], }, }; ``` Commands can still provide a `run(context)` callback for advanced editor-only behavior, but the default UI only ships portable Markdown snippets. ## Imperative Handle ```svelte ``` The handle exposes `focus`, `getMarkdown`, `setMarkdown`, `getMode`, `setMode`, `getSelection`, `setSelection`, `insertMarkdown`, and `setReadonly`.

## Markdown Coverage

The demo and docs live examples cover the portable Markdown surface: frontmatter, headings, inline formatting, links, wikilinks, tags, Markdown embeds, lists, task lists, blockquotes, callouts, pipe tables, grid tables, fenced code, syntax highlighting, KaTeX math, images, raw HTML, directives, footnotes, and Mermaid diagrams.

## Modes

| Mode           | Behavior                                                               |
| :------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source`       | Raw Markdown editing.                                                  |
| `live-preview` | CodeMirror editing with rendered widgets for inactive Markdown blocks. |
| `preview`      | Reading view backed by the same Markdown renderer.                     |
| `split`        | Editor and preview side by side.                                       |

## Source Toggle

Live widgets expose a source affordance when raw Markdown editing is needed. The editor restores the original source range and keeps focus in the CodeMirror surface.

## Syntax Anatomy

```md
+--------+-------+
| Header | Cell |
+========+=======+
| Body | Cell |
+--------+-------+
```

Use `+`, `-`, and `|` to mark the grid. A line with `=` separates header, body, and footer sections. Missing column delimiters create column spans, and missing row delimiters create row spans.

## Alignment Markers

```md
+:-----:+ +------:+ +---v---+
| center | | right | | bottom|
+-------+ +--------+ +-------+
```

Horizontal alignment is marked with `:`, `>`, and `<` on the grid line above a cell. Vertical alignment is marked with `^`, `x`, or `v`.

These examples are adapted from the syntax documented by [`adobe/remark-gridtables`](https://github.com/adobe/remark-gridtables).
